root_completion.source: Explicit operator confirmation of actual root completion; not inferred from report status.

mission_evidence_scope: Exact unique supervisor terminal filename, raw SHA256 and epoch verified.

navigation.scope: Recorded sends joined by unique token; failure includes cancellation. Duplicate/absent terminals stay unknown.

observation_queue.scope: Actual queue denominator includes skipped/failed/pending/active. Relocation counts shifted goal sends, not physical displacement or arrival. Inspection completion is separate; neither implies visual coverage.

native.scope: Native Gazebo world samples only; no map/world identity assumption. Distance is measured displacement from the home bracket, not a return acceptance result. Equal bracket endpoints are sampled evidence, not continuous stationarity.

shutdown.limitation: SIGKILL cannot guarantee bounded exit from uninterruptible kernel I/O

retention.scope: Original strict audit of reopened accepted RGB-D files; verified_count counts frame pairs, not independent file objects. No repeat pixel audit. Failed 0/0 audit never replaces a nonzero consumer ledger or becomes a pass.

target_observation_camera_frame_unavaila.scope: Target observation rejection because camera frame is absent; separate from stale base TF and navigation extrapolation. Ordering is file-line order, not a wall/ROS clock conversion.

target_observation_camera_frame_unavaila.scope: Target observation rejection because camera frame is absent; separate from stale base TF and navigation extrapolation. Ordering is file-line order, not a wall/ROS clock conversion.

tf_diagnostics.scope: Substring log-line counts are diagnostics, not unique faults. The node records only its first TF age rejection; missing events do not certify zero rejected lookups.

relocation_gate_as_recorded.scope: Read-only live receipt after Mission loaded/save-early; not a pre-first-goal claim.

conventions.origin: metric lower-left corner of cell (0,0); yaw in radians, no half-cell shift
conventions.yaml_thresholds: fixed Nav2 trinary reload thresholds; distinct from input classification

limitations: No live map service was called or repaired; source report is unchanged.
Trinary export preserves unknowns and classifies intermediate probabilities as unknown; raw probabilities remain in source JSON.
YAML has no frame field; use the recorded frame_id when configuring map_server.
File readback does not prove complete mapping, visual coverage, navigation safety, or mission success.

closure.global_scan_limitation: Some same-UID /proc environments unreadable; no global absence claim

expected.tf_stamp_policy: Unchanged ROS scan stamp plus transform_timeout; restamp_tf=false.

live_slam_overlay_gate.scope: Actual owned process /proc/maps path, SHA, inode/device and stable PID; package prefix alone is insufficient. Snapshot after mission startup, not before the first goal.

limitations: No world/target truth read; annotation count is not target recall.
Actual queue completion is a bounded observation milestone, not full-maze visual coverage or mission success.
Original false/unknown flags and failures are preserved. No aggregate benchmark-success flag is invented.
Accepted frame count, original file audit and original mission completion are separate evidence.
The explicit root receipt and owned/writer closure do not prove global process absence.
